name: Gusu Beauties of the Four Seasons–Summer
aliases: 四季姑蘇美人圖 - 夏
material: Multicolor woodblock print; ink and color on paper, framed
summary: “Beautiful women” (meiren) was a popular subject in prints from Suzhou, a city that set trends in fashion and art. This print is from a set of Four Beauties representing the Four Seasons, along with CMA 2025.48, CMA 2025.50, and CMA 2025.51.
